scripts.lint-is-a-root-gate: node -e "console.error('Linting is a ROOT gate in this repository: one flat config at the repo root, which resolves its own plugins from the root. Run: npx eslint packages/analytics --max-warnings 0 from the repository root. A package-local lint script cannot work without the root install (measured: exit 2, Cannot find package @eslint/js imported from <root>/eslint.config.mjs), and a second config here would be a second truth.'); process.exit(2)"
